description: Bumps the wolfSSL tag+SHA pin in dockerfile, the digest of its Debian base, and the SHA-pinned actions in the publish workflow. A green pull request merges itself; see README.md.

customManagers.description: A '# renovate:' comment followed by the ARG <NAME>_TAG and ARG <NAME>_SHA pair it describes.

packageRules.description: A major is platform work, not a bump (SUPPORT.md in solid-syslog): it waits on the Dependency Dashboard until someone ticks it.

A major never merges itself. An upstream major is platform work (SUPPORT.md in solid-syslog), and a GitHub Action's major is where its inputs change, which a pull request cannot exercise for the login, push and notify steps that run only on main. Renovate assigns the pull request to the maintainer when it opens.
The Debian base is named by its tag and pinned by digest, so a refreshed bookworm-slim is a digest update that rebuilds the image on it.
